1 · First half

How it started.

The Suns led 29–18 after one quarter. At the half, the Suns led 64–47.

2 · The difference

Goodwin: 18 points, 6 of 7 from three

18 points in 14 minutes, in his first game back from a calf injury.

3 · How it turned

Up 17 at the half, up as many as 32 in the third

Seven Suns scored 10 or more.

4 · Where it was won

Won it from three and off the bench

Bench points 81–62; assists 32–28. Phoenix shot 51 percent from three.

5 · Final

Suns 133, Clippers 110.
